description: This file contains mock implementations of a subcontainers info provider for testing purposes within the 'metrics' package of the 'cadvisor' project. It defines classes and methods to simulate retrieving version, machine, and container info, including error scenarios.

classes.name: testSubcontainersInfoProvider
classes.description: A mock provider for subcontainer info used in testing.

classes.name: erroringSubcontainersInfoProvider
classes.description: A wrapper provider that can simulate failures for testing error handling.

methods.name: GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Returns static version info or an error based on the provider.

methods.name: GetMachineInfo
methods.description: Returns static machine info or an error based on the provider.

methods.name: GetRequestedContainersInfo
methods.description: Returns container info map or an error, optionally failing based on the provider.
